newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee end mixed but near day's highs.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee end mixed but near day's highs.

text.p: Robusta coffee futures finished mixed but near the day's highs on late short-covering and trade buying on Friday following a slight rebound in New York, traders said.
They said light industry and commission house buying helped counter early long liquidation.
There was also some arbitrage buying to sell against New York when the U.S. market opens later on Friday.
But overall volume was a light 2,687 lots.
Values headed south after the open on liquidation after news that the Colombian truckers' strike ended after 11 days.
"This is basically a bearish factor," said one trader.
By the close finish, most-active January stood $1 lower at $1,383 a tonne.
But front-month November bucked the bearish trend, standing $15 higher at $1,525 and widening its already-large premium to January to $142.

Colombian truckers began climbing back behind the wheel early on Friday after their leaders signed an agreement with the government to end a crippling 11-day-old strike, which some exporters say had hampered coffee shipments.
Traders also noted news New York's Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange (CSCE) would investigate recent errors in reporting coffee stocks made at one warehouse.
